description: Dublin Metropolitan Area Cycle Infrastructure 2025 is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Transport Authority. This data set shows where cycle infrastructure exists in Dublin Metropolitan Area on both sides of the road. The categories it includes are: 1. Segregated Cycle Tracks and Protected Cycle Lanes which are within road, physically separated from traffic and pedestrians, includes bollards, and can be one way or two way 2. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher National Transport Authority. Its tags are active travel, cycle infrastructure, dublin, dublin bikes, open data. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
